activity_summary: After the play you had been Gaunt. You died in the play and stood at the tiring-house door after. The jaw held. You did not bring the morning onto that stage. Nick is not mended. The page is still one page, and the bundle stays tied.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the part, refused a cure, and left the page untouched.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Named as unmended, and not in the room.

entities.name: the king play
